fact: BOCONGO's board chairperson told the minister at a dialogue with civil society that the Constitutional Court process must rest on meaningful, structured, inclusive participation, that consultations must go beyond mere formality, and called for clear public information and more time; the document gives the date as the Monday before its 10 Feb 2026 report.

Botswana's Daily News reports that Moeladilotlhoko News Boiler director Tshepo Sethibe was charged under Penal Code section 59(1) with publishing alarming information on Facebook alleging deceitfulness in the police handling of a disappearance; the state withdrew the charge in October 2024.
